sourceOfTruth: Reto oficial de Empleabilidad, brainstorm del equipo y decisiones confirmadas durante grill-with-docs

designUnderReview.name: Puente Laboral Panamá
designUnderReview.goal: Evaluar la aptitud de un joven para una vacante, reconocer experiencia formal e informal, identificar brechas y proponer una ruta accionable antes de postular.
primaryFlow: capturar CV, certificaciones, proyectos y experiencias descritas por el usuario
analizar los requisitos de una oferta
calcular aptitud con reglas y restricciones determinísticas
proponer cursos, certificaciones o pasantías como roadmap
solicitar aprobación humana antes de ejecutar una acción externa

primaryUseCase.name: What jobs can I apply to?
primaryUseCase.actor: Young candidate without a strong CV or with informal experience.
flow: upload a CV photo/PDF or describe experiences
describe projects, family work, volunteering or previous employment
Profile Agent identifies technical skills, soft skills, estimated level and missing evidence
Google Maps validates transport and location
Training Agent recommends courses, projects or internships

candidatePreferences.rule: Preferences are explicitly selected by the candidate and are not inferred by the LLM.

skillsTaxonomy.localExtension: Panamanian Spanish occupation and skills dictionary
skillsTaxonomy.llmBoundary: LLM proposes mappings; canonical skills are validated before solver use and the original term is preserved.

rules: LLM may propose a level
level requires evidence
declared-only skill cannot exceed 1
verified credential does not automatically imply expert
compare candidate and job levels deterministically
candidate may correct proposed level
counselor reviews material discrepancies

vacancySources.role: Update the cached vacancy catalog; never become a critical live dependency.
rules: disable enrichCompany
ignore closed vacancies
retain jobUrl, query date and scrapingInfo
record provider, cost, timestamp and errors
manual vacancy import is the fallback
confirm competition and applicable terms before use

freshnessPolicy.uiRequirement: Show last-updated timestamp for every vacancy.

rules: relax only soft preferences
never relax hard constraints silently
show near matches with warnings
activate Training Agent for a roadmap
allow a future-search alert
never invent vacancies or hide constraints

alertPolicy.delivery: new matches shown in the candidate dashboard
alertPolicy.audit: record alert and match events in the event store

languagePolicy.explanationRule: Show evidence, applied rules and verifiable decisions; never expose private chain-of-thought.

requirements: text alternatives for images and audio

criteria: complete primary flow in under 3 minutes
four agents communicate through the workflow graph
at least one real tool executes: Google Maps, Apify, PostgreSQL write or HiGHS
100 percent of hard constraints are enforced
complete trace_id is visible for each demo
show apt, apt_with_gaps and not_currently_apt outcomes
Docker Alpine local demo and Vercel/Neon backup work

proposedAgents.name: Agente de Exploración
proposedAgents.purpose: Permitir tantear oportunidades, describir experiencias y descubrir qué empleos son plausibles sin postular automáticamente.

proposedAgents.name: Agente de Perfil y Evidencia
proposedAgents.purpose: Interpretar CV, certificaciones, cursos, proyectos y experiencia informal; clasificar evidencia útil y detectar información faltante.

proposedAgents.name: Agente de Mercado y Matching
proposedAgents.purpose: Normalizar requisitos empresariales, invocar el evaluador determinístico, medir brechas, construir el roadmap y preparar la postulación.

proposedAgents.name: Agente de Formación
proposedAgents.purpose: Buscar y normalizar oportunidades públicas de formación, mantener el catálogo cacheado y entregar opciones al solver.

deterministicComponents: evaluación de requisitos obligatorios y deseables
validación de certificaciones contra evidencia disponible
restricciones de transporte, horario y salario
ranking de cursos/pasantías por cobertura de brecha, costo, cupo y accesibilidad
pruebas de estabilidad ante cambios de nombre, género o corregimiento
clasificación de resultados de verificación como verdadero positivo, verdadero negativo, falso positivo y falso negativo

verificationStages: extract certificate document and issuer identity
verify issuer signature using the public key
check certificate trust and revocation status
orderedProviders.integrationBoundary: Use a separately deployed Certo instance and its documented public verification/API surface; do not place Certo source code inside the application monorepo.
orderedProviders.deployment: separate service/repository outside the application monorepo
orderedProviders.licenseReview: Certo is AGPL-3.0; preserve attribution and review obligations before deployment or modification.

clientIntegration.rule: Never expose the Certo token to the browser.

limitations: Certo is an open-source credential platform, not proof that every external certificate is supported
deployment and API contract must be confirmed
issuer trust and revocation data must be available for a positive verification

orderedProviders.purpose: verificación alternativa para certificados no verificados por certo
verificación alternativa para certificados no verificados por certo

certificateVerificationPolicy.fallbackRule: Solo se consulta el siguiente proveedor cuando certo no puede verificar el certificado; se conserva la evidencia y el motivo de cada resultado.
certificateVerificationPolicy.mandatoryCredentialRule: A mandatory credential counts as satisfied only when status is verified.

canonicalContract.rule: Certo, Accredible and Credly adapters must emit the same normalized contract before matching.

holderBinding.rule: A credential is verified only when authenticity/revocation and candidate identity binding both pass.
holderBinding.exception: Candidate may provide additional evidence; only a counselor may approve an exception.
holderBinding.privacy: Compare pseudonymized identifiers in the backend; never send full identity data to the LLM.

certificateVerificationPolicy.safetyRule: No afirmar autenticidad cuando la fuente no entrega evidencia verificable.

applicationPolicy.humanGate: El envío requiere aprobación humana explícita después de revisar CV, carta, datos y destinatario.

experiencePolicy.evidenceRule: La experiencia declarada puede aportar evidencia de una habilidad, pero nunca se convierte automáticamente en una certificación.
experiencePolicy.normalization: El agente traduce la descripción a habilidades, contexto, nivel estimado y evidencia; el solver decide su peso según la vacante.

rules: obtain explicit consent before storing or submitting data
separate identifying data from ranking features
exclude name, gender, age, photo and nationality from ranking
retain protected attributes only when necessary for bias audits
allow correction and deletion
record provenance as declared, extracted, verified or inferred

geographicPolicy.inPersonRule: Una vacante presencial debe ser compatible con la ubicación geográfica, tiempo máximo de traslado y costo máximo de transporte aceptados por el usuario.
geographicPolicy.deterministicTreatment: La compatibilidad geográfica se evalúa como restricción dura o advertencia explícita según los límites declarados por el usuario.
geographicPolicy.routingFallback: Matriz local determinística de zonas, tiempos y costos estimados.
geographicPolicy.routingRule: La API calcula rutas; el código aplica los límites y decide compatibilidad. El LLM no decide tiempos ni costos.
geographicPolicy.costRule: Usar costo de Google Maps cuando esté disponible; de lo contrario, usar presupuesto declarado y tabla local de tarifas estimadas.
geographicPolicy.remoteAndHybrid: Las vacantes remotas o híbridas se evalúan con sus días presenciales y restricciones correspondientes.

inputPolicy.scopeLimit: No se requiere audio en vivo para el MVP; el audio debe llegar como transcripción o convertirse previamente a texto.
inputPolicy.sharedPipeline: Todas las entradas se convierten a texto con provenance antes de la extracción estructurada.

trainingCatalogPolicy.specializationScope: El catálogo se filtra y pondera según el área de especialización y las brechas del candidato.
trainingCatalogPolicy.availabilityRule: El flujo principal usa el último snapshot válido; el agente puede actualizarlo y registrar cambios sin bloquear matching.
trainingCatalogPolicy.safetyBoundary: Solo consultar contenido público permitido; respetar términos, límites y robots de cada plataforma; no evadir controles ni inventar datos.
trainingCatalogPolicy.humanReview: Las oportunidades extraídas deben poder ser revisadas antes de entrar al catálogo recomendado.

graphEngineeringAssessment.explanation: El MVP usa un grafo de estados y transiciones entre agentes; un grafo de conocimiento de habilidades puede agregarse como componente de datos, pero no es obligatorio para la primera demo.

agentFramework.rationale: TypeScript-native agents, graph workflows with suspend/resume for human approval, built-in evals, guardrails, Langfuse tracing and a local Studio for the live demo.
agentFramework.rejectedFor: Requires assembling evals, guardrails and UI separately within the 24-hour window.

ui.rationale: Shares the Mastra/Vercel AI SDK runtime and enables a credible reviewer dashboard quickly.

persistence.rationale: Typed models, migrations and a real database-write action; supports audit and traceability.
persistence.fallback: SQLite with Prisma if Docker is unavailable during the event.

solver.rationale: Genuine MILP (branch-and-cut), MIT, WebAssembly, no native add-ons; models capacities and hard constraints declaratively.
solver.fallback: Deterministic greedy heuristic in pure TypeScript so the live demo never fails.

models.matching: binary x[candidate, job]; maximize weighted compatibility; hard constraints on slots, transport, schedule, salary and mandatory requirements
models.roadmap: binary y[course]; maximize gap coverage subject to budget, duration and availability

documentIntake.rationale: Native PDF text extraction first, a vision model for messy photos and handwriting, and a local OCR fallback for offline demos.

llmProvider.integration: @openrouter/ai-sdk-provider inside the Mastra model router (Vercel AI SDK)

failoverLayers.provider: OpenRouter is automatic by default (allow_fallbacks: true); shape with only, ignore, order, preferred_max_latency.
failoverLayers.model: Opt-in ordered models array; triggers on rate limit, context-length errors, moderation flags and downtime; failed requests are not billed.

piInspiredOrchestration: same provider first, then other providers for the same model
sticky swap per session, restored on reset
forward-only fallback pointer, never retry a failed fallback in the same session
compact context before switching to a smaller-context model
terminal floor model at the end of every chain
llmProvider.budgetRule: Per-agent token budgets because the OpenRouter quota is shared across agents.

layers.langfuse: LLM traces via OpenTelemetry from Mastra: prompts, tools, tokens, latency, retries and model fallbacks.
layers.audit_events: Append-only PostgreSQL record of system decisions: matching, applied constraints, certificate verification and human approval.
layers.event_store_dql: Queryable event store with explicit lifecycle states for failed, successful and pending events.

rules: a trace_id propagates to profiles, matches, roadmap and decisions
each decision records agent, tool, applied constraint and supporting evidence
model fallback is logged with attempted model and reason
Mastra Studio is used as the local viewer during the demo

eventStore.dqlValue: Domain Query Language (option 1) plus Dead-letter Queue Log (option 3)
eventStore.pendingMeaning: Esperando aprobación humana o reintento programado.
eventStore.failedMeaning: Agotó reintentos; queda en vista dead-letter para revisión.
eventStore.queryInterface: Capa DQL de solo lectura sobre el event store con vistas derivadas: events.failed, events.pending, events.by_trace(trace_id).
eventStore.deadLetterQueue: Vista y flujo dedicado para eventos fallidos: reintento manual o programado, inspección de error y trazabilidad.
eventStore.relationshipToAuditEvents: audit_events conserva la verdad append-only; el event store modela transiciones de estado.

deployment.compatibilityNote: Validate Prisma, native OCR dependencies and any Node modules against Alpine; use a compatible libc strategy or switch only the affected service to a Debian-based image if required.
deployment.rationale: Reproducible offline-first local demo with a cloud fallback.

packageManager.rationale: Keeps the recommended monorepo boundaries while using the team's requested standard npm tooling.

contracts.runtimeValidation: Ajv validating JSON Schema 2020-12; no Zod runtime or source schemas.

authentication.demoMode: Pre-seeded demo accounts plus normal session validation
rules: explicit consent before persistence or submission
role-based route protection
server-side session validation
no real credentials in repository
authentication.nextJsNote: Use Node.js runtime for middleware session validation and configure Better Auth as a server external package.

runtimeBoundaries.web: Next.js UI, sessions and backend-for-frontend API
runtimeBoundaries.rule: The frontend does not directly control agents or the solver.

serviceCommunication.sse: Stream progress, state and event updates.
serviceCommunication.validation: JSON Schema 2020-12 with Ajv for every request and response.
serviceCommunication.reliability: Retries with idempotency for sensitive actions.

rules: document names only in .env.example with fake values
store real secrets only in local environment files or deployment secret stores
never expose provider keys to the browser
restrict Google Maps keys by domain or IP and quota
use a separate secret for web-to-agent-runtime communication
validate required variables at startup
support mocks for external services in development and tests

guardrails.toolPolicy: Each tool declares authorized agents, authorized roles, read/write permissions, input/output schemas, rate limits, trace_id and risk level.
guardrails.llmBoundary: LLMs may interpret, extract and explain; they may not authenticate credentials, calculate aptitude, alter ranking, override constraints, approve submissions, or invent opportunities.
guardrails.mastraCompatibility: Use Mastra processors while keeping JSON Schema 2020-12 and Ajv as the contract source of truth; validate the adapter in an early spike.

fallbackRules: fallback must satisfy the same required capabilities
fallback list is ordered and forward-only per run
do not retry a failed model in the same run
compact context before selecting a smaller context window
preserve structured output contract across fallbacks
use a low-cost floor model only when it satisfies the contract
modelPolicy.criticalPathRule: Aptitude, matching, credential verification and authorization never depend on LLM output; model failure routes to a deterministic fallback or human review.
modelPolicy.deploymentRule: Model IDs are selected at deployment from an allowlisted, versioned configuration and can change without code changes.
modelPolicy.validation: Startup rejects a registry entry that lacks required capabilities or exceeds configured budget.

modelPreflight.failureBehavior: Disable the failing model before workflow execution and promote the next compatible fallback.
modelPreflight.evidence: Store a preflight report with model IDs, capabilities, timestamps, results and disabled entries.

piiProtection.architecture: local PII vault with pseudonymized LLM context
piiProtection.rule: Only the approved application-generation step may rehydrate authorized fields.

retentionPolicy.demoData: Delete at the end of the demo session.
retentionPolicy.originalDocuments: Retain only while the workflow requires them.
retentionPolicy.profilesAndMatches: Retain through the demo for traceability.
retentionPolicy.userControl: Candidate can request manual deletion from the dashboard.

authorization.candidate: Must approve submission of their own application.
authorization.counselor: Must approve critical gaps, unverified credentials, bias alerts or infeasible transport; may correct agent decisions.
authorization.employer: Must approve the shortlist before interview progression.
authorization.agentBoundary: Agents may prepare, explain and route decisions, but cannot bypass role-based approval gates.
authorization.auditRequirement: Every approval, correction and rejection records actor, role, timestamp, trace_id and reason.

verificationGroundTruth.purpose: Medir verdaderos positivos, verdaderos negativos, falsos positivos y falsos negativos contra resultados conocidos.

outcomes.meaning: Cumple los requisitos obligatorios y las restricciones prácticas de la vacante.
Puede avanzar, pero tiene brechas accionables de cursos, certificaciones, experiencia o preparación.
Incumple una restricción dura, como una certificación obligatoria no verificada, horario incompatible o transporte inviable.

aptitudePolicy.rule: El estado nunca se determina solo por el LLM; se calcula a partir de requisitos normalizados, evidencia y restricciones determinísticas.

softSkillsPolicy.declaredOnlyRule: Self-declared soft skills receive limited weight and may require interview or additional evidence.
softSkillsPolicy.doubleCountingRule: Soft skills demonstrated through experience are not counted again in technical requirements.

aptitudeThresholds.hardConstraintOverride: Any failed hard constraint can produce not_currently_apt regardless of score.

conditions: candidate is adjacent to the next higher tier
no better eligible candidate exists in the current proposal or shortlist
borderlineTolerance.audit: Record original score, target tier, comparison set, reason, reviewer and final decision.

tieBreakPolicy.audit: Record the first criterion that resolved the tie.

rules: block clearly prohibited requirements
send ambiguous or potentially discriminatory requirements to human review
request objective reformulation from the employer
exclude flagged criteria from ranking while under review
record alert and correction in audit_events
jobFairnessPolicy.override: Only an authorized human reviewer may resolve a flagged requirement; agents cannot silently override it.

roadmapPolicy.selectionMethod: deterministic ranking by gap coverage, constraints, accessibility and expected effort
roadmapPolicy.llmBoundary: El LLM puede explicar y personalizar la ruta, pero no inventar oportunidades ni alterar el ranking determinístico.

requiredActions: persistir perfil, evaluación y decisión humana
generar CV adaptado a una oferta
preparar una postulación o shortlist para aprobación humana
documentationCandidates: glossary: aptitud, evidencia, brecha, roadmap, experiencia informal, postulación adaptada
ADR: alcance y nivel de verificación de certificaciones
ADR: límites de autonomía y aprobación humana
CONTEXT.md: actores, vocabulario y fronteras del dominio

unresolved.question: Is the separate Certo deployment and API contract available and authorized before the competition?
unresolved.recommendation: Run a pre-event integration check; use the transparent mock adapter if unavailable. This is an implementation validation, not a design blocker.

skippedValidations: Certo deployment, API contract and authorization still require a pre-event validation; the adapter and mock are the accepted fallback.
nextConsumer: to-spec: convert the accepted context into a typed project specification
